statement: For the full peripheral outer centralizer of any negative once-punctured-torus involution b, the action on its primitive fixed homology line is a single global sign sigma. Together with the actual peripheral multiplier lambda, this determines the entire integral homology matrix as (sigma/2)((1+lambda)I+(1-lambda)A). The kernel of the exact character map is precisely the torsion-free IA centralizer, canonically represented by the actual automorphisms fixing the named cusp and commuting with the chosen cusp reflection. Every finite subgroup of this centralizer embeds faithfully into the four dyadic matrices I, -I, A_2, -A_2.
depends_on: D55 full primary faithfulness on finite torus subgroups; D58 actual negative extension and full cusp normalizer; D59 primitive fixed homology line and cusp fixed subgroup contained in the closed derived subgroup; D62 exact all-unit and both-label transporter cosets; full peripheral centralizer and centre-freeness
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The extension is constructed directly from the actual full inverse image of the negative involution in Aut(F), and every normalization is an explicitly specified inner conjugation.
notes: An arbitrary centralizing outer representative acts by conjugation on the full inverse image E. After its cusp conjugator and the exact half-exponent inner correction, it carries c to c^lambda and v to c^i v, with i in {0,1}; this normalized representative is unique. Applying it to the actual transporter gives fixed-line action (-1)^i, by D62. The determinant is the peripheral character in the exact Heisenberg commutator quotient. The rational eigenspace calculation descends to the actual integral matrices, because the half-coefficients are full profinite integers. The image Xi_b is only the actual image of the two characters; no surjectivity onto the full product is asserted. The IA kernel is canonically the actual cusp-fixing automorphism centralizer and is torsion-free, but its triviality is unresolved. The finite bound is faithful into a Klein four matrix group; occurrence of a four-element subgroup for each arbitrary b is not asserted.
computational_checks: The result is proved by the explicit extension, transporter, character and matrix maps. The two reflection-label transporter identities used here were executed in code/part_c/torus_unit_transporters_d62.py. No additional finite enumeration is required for the universal matrix identity or the torsion-free kernel conclusion.
